title: Static Radio schedule (schedule-wear.json, schema_version 8)
description: The public schedule at https://data.staticradio.app/schedule-wear.json. Every station is a loop of episodes that started at daily_epoch_utc, with 1.5 s of silence after each episode. How to work out what's live: https://staticradio.app/developers#whats-live. New fields can appear at any time without a version change, so ignore any you don't know. We'll give notice before schema_version changes.

schema_version.description: The format version. 8 for this schema.

daily_epoch_utc.description: When the loops started: midnight US Central at the start of the broadcast day this file was built for. A new file goes on air as soon as it's published, usually around 7 a.m. Central the day before, so this is often in the future. Wrap with a modulo that never goes negative.

categories.description: The stations, keyed by station id (for example news_01). Only stations on the air are listed. Order them by sort_index.

id.description: The station id, the same as its key in categories.

u_tag.description: The station's name as it appears on the dial, in capitals.

is_active.description: Always true in this file; inactive stations are left out.

loop_duration_seconds.description: Length of the station's loop in seconds, NOT counting the 1.5 s gaps. Equal to the sum of the episodes' durationInSeconds.

palette.description: The station's colors: bg (background) and two accents a and b.

episodeId.description: A stable id for the episode. Bulletins are bulletin-<id> and can appear several times in one loop.

audioUrl.description: The audio, on the show's own host (bulletins are on data.staticradio.app or bulletin.staticradio.app). Stream it from here; follow redirects; never cache, re-host or proxy it. A few are plain http.

startOffsetSeconds.description: The sum of the earlier episodes' durations, WITHOUT the 1.5 s gaps. Don't use it for timing; walk the episodes instead.

durationInSeconds.description: How long the episode holds the air, in seconds. Its slot is this plus 1.5 s. Episodes with 0 are skipped.

imageUrl.description: Cover art, usually https://data.staticradio.app/art/<hash>.webp. A few are a relative path to art bundled in our apps (SHEILA B), which you can't fetch; use your own fallback for anything that isn't an absolute URL.

title.description: The episode's title. "Community Bulletin" for bulletins.

feedTitle.description: The show's name. "Static Radio Bulletin Board" for bulletins.

episodeUrl.description: The episode's web page, or the bulletin's link. Can be empty.

feedUrl.description: The show's RSS feed. Empty for bulletins.

gainDb.description: Loudness correction in dB (EBU R128), so stations sit at a similar level. Optional to apply.

isBulletin.description: True for a community bulletin. Bulletins play for at most 30 s.

placementId.description: Bulletins only: an id for the break this bulletin fills.

supportUrl.description: Optional. The show's own support page, from the podcast:funding tag in its RSS feed. Show it as a "Support" link while the episode plays. Left out when the show has none, and on bulletins. Added 2026-11-11. Older files have no supportUrl on any episode; for those, read podcast:funding from feedUrl.

image_analysis.description: Colors picked from the cover art. On one episode per station only.
